name: FIGHT FINDER
creator: Gormundr
description: FIGHT FINDER (originally released as Sky Stadium) is a PC and Quest compatible arena world co-created by Gormundr along with Mortugues, Wobblins, N1no001, and KazeTheAlien. It's built around stadium-style spaces where visitors perform choreographed roleplay fights and showcase avatar animations for recognition within affiliated combat and roleplay sub-groups. After growing quickly in mid-2024, the world and its Discord were rebranded as a permanent public hub supporting many independent fighting-roleplay communities.
